Subject: Aligning execs + focused infra walkthrough to unblock pilot (VaultPay)

Kaitlyn — great to meet earlier today. Quick recap and next steps so we have shared expectations before looping in your VP/CTO: 

- What we heard: VaultPay needs predictable per-tenant isolation, proof of audit logs for transaction flows, and a low-latency embedding index for real-time fraud scoring.
- What we propose next: 1) a short executive intro (VP on your side + our Head of Product / CTO) to confirm business objectives and timeline for a pilot; 2) a focused technical walkthrough (30–45m) for your infra/engineering team to validate integration approach and SSO/KMS details.

Can you share 2–3 windows next week for an executive sync? Ideally a 30-minute slot with your VP and CTO (we'll include Laura B. from product and I will join). After that we can book the technical deep dive and drop a lightweight mutual action plan.

I attached the discovery notes and a workbook of retention/retention-expectations you referenced.

Thanks — appreciate the momentum.

— Marcus
Marcus Lin
